frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The four-part closed-end fund puzzle (start at a premium, drift to a discount, discounts comove and mean-revert, discounts shrink on open-ending) is evidence for systematic individual-investor sentiment rather than agency, tax, or illiquidity costs.
